frozen_target.question: Can the complete maximal-scale even medium/long residual Fejer aggregate (165.K26) be bounded by L^3X^epsilon through exact parity-Fejer dyadic bandpasses and a common-frequency finite character-Poisson transform before every positive dual-mode sum, or what is the first exact parity, endpoint, transform, bandpass, restored-power, collar-return, or owner-scope no-go?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For z_N=c_N^rem e(J sqrt(N)), D_L=sum_N|c_N^rem|^2<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon, R_0=ceil(L), and M=M_L asymp L^2, prove T_26=Re sum_(R_0<=r<M, 2|r)(1-r/M) sum_N z_(N+r)conj(z_N)<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon. With F_R(theta)=R^(-1)|sum_(0<=j<R)e(j theta)|^2 and K_R^(2)=(F_R(theta)+F_R(theta+1/2))/2, E_R^(2)=int_0^1|Z(theta)|^2K_R^(2)(theta)dtheta. Along R_(j+1)=min(2R_j,M), T_26 is one half of the sum of adjacent-scale E^(2) increments minus a target-safe short-shift correction.
quantities: J=sqrt(X), 1<<L<<H<=J^(1/2), R_0=ceil(L), and a containing interval has M_L asymp L^2 sites.

The coefficient c_N^rem is the complete literal residual coefficient with every selector, no-pair row, squarefree mask, chi_4 factor, complementary parity branch, profile, floor, star, crossing, endpoint, point value, and zero-extension jump retained.
There is one outer real part; no shiftwise, rowwise, Mobius-wise, Poisson-mode-wise, or product-cell-wise modulus is licensed before the factor-L saving.
The positive coefficient-uniform capacity is L^4X^epsilon and the target is L^3X^epsilon, so the missing saving is exactly one factor L at the top scale.
The even shifts below R_0 are paid once within L^3X^epsilon and cannot fund a second positive loss.

The exact doubling increment has zero diagonal, a triangular-tent correlation kernel, and an equivalent block-energy minus Haar-detail identity; the last non-doubling link uses the exact Fejer difference.
K26 closes only the complete residual t=1 scalar through accepted connectors; all other hard-TOP channels and every downstream parent remain separate.

Price transformed diagonal, zero modes, endpoints, transitions, and the signed dual off-diagonal by L^3X^epsilon, or isolate the first exact restored L^4 term or coefficientwise collar self-return.
Retain selected and no-pair rows, squarefree and coprimality holes, both complementary parity branches, profiles, floors, stars, crossings, endpoints, point values, and zero extension throughout.
Pass dechirped-array, one-site, no-pair positive-sign, global-Parseval, both-Fejer-peak, short-budget, collar-restoration, statement-only, and owner-scope controls.
Prove K26, an owner-complete strict spectral/dyadic sector with target-safe complement, or the smallest exact dyadic-character-Poisson route no-go.
Close under exactly one campaign terminal label and do not pivot inside the round.
